# Chiefly

> Chiefly makes Jarvis, a personal chief of staff that lives on your computer. You pay once and it's yours — no subscription, no datacenter watching over your shoulder. It's built for people who want their AI working for them, not for someone else's business model.

Chiefly is the company. Jarvis is the product: a personal chief of staff that lives on your computer.

The waitlist is open. A private alpha runs in October 2026.

## Principles

- You own it. You don’t rent it.
- It lives on your computer.
- Privacy by design. It works for you, and only you.
- You can delete it anytime.

## Names

- Company: Chiefly
- Product: Jarvis
- Site: https://chieflyos.com/
